name: mirage
text: v1.0.114 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.114 . DG3: the phone now keeps only open bets and the last 35 days. Older settled bets are removed from the phone only after their day's file is confirmed on GitHub (phone-data branch), so nothing is lost. Bet history before that is read from GitHub by me, not the phone. Open item: cold start (DG1b).
